comment: Bunn is good at explaining concepts, but he does not cover all of them that appear on assignments, so I recommend reading the textbook. He gives chapter numbers. Especially reference them for homework. There were too many students for him to help during labs (and we all needed help), however, he was helpful in office hours. He is a tough grader.
Smart, funny guy. If you do the practice questions for the exams you'll be fine. Grade is 17.5% for each exam (there are two), 25% for the final, 15% for hw, 15% for quizzes, and 10% for lab.
Do not take him. 80% of class average and never round up. Tough grader on homework and exams.

He is very smart but unprepared. Lectures are brief, and most of class is spent in lab with minimal guidance. He never covers how to solve HW, quiz, or exam problems, forcing you to self-teach. He gives work solutions, but they are unhelpful and confusing as they are typed out and skip important steps. Grading is slow and gives no helpful feedback.

I like Dr. Bunn personally, but I wouldn't take his class again. In lectures, he finished examples early, stating "you can work the rest of it out later." There were low exam grades (which weren't curved) due to cancelled office hours, 65% of class time was spent on labs (worth 15%), and we often taught ourselves on HW (graded on accuracy by TA).

Dr. Bunn is very intelligent, but he does very little to help students grasp the material. His lectures always take a very brief look at the basics of the topics, and then we spend an unnecessary amount of time doing labs that don't help us learn. He's slow at grading and doesn't prepare very much for class or actually help practice. Very confusing

Dr. Bunn is one of the best professors, always excited and energetic about the material even when he knows his students aren't, always eager to help you out when you get stuck with hw or lab. His classes would genuinely make my day. They are lecture heavy but you can be on your phone or laptop during the lecture as long as you work during the lab.
Extremely enthusiastic and energetic. Lectures can get boring and long, but you can use your laptop during them. If you need to take a science gened, take him.

He's great at walking you through the steps of problems. Responds to emails promptly. Assigns homework pretty frequently, but it's not too much at a time (homework graded for accuracy). 2 exams and a final (plus scattered quizzes here and there). Textbook isn't required (except for some homework problems), but it helps. Has a sense of humor.
hes so cute and stutters sometimes. hes a fun guy but if you are not into astrophysics or anything like that dont take it. no tests, just essays as major grades. not a bad class to take!

Dr. Bunn goes out of his way to make sure everyone in the room understands every concept he covers, which can be aggravating if you're a major taking the intro classes, but he's absolutely the best professor in the department for intro classes because of how much he cares.

Dr. Bunn (Astrophysics w/lab) is my favorite professor this semester. He is enthusiastic/engaging in class. He gives homework consistently, but not too much of it. He is extremely helpful if you have a problem/need help. He divides time well between lectures and lab. Tests can be challenging, but he prepares you well. Highly recommended!

Dr. Bunn is great! I had him for Space is Big and his class was not hard at all. He assigns readings that are due the next day of class and he will give a one question quiz. Essays aren't hard or long but he asks for you to be very clear. You have no finals or test but one presentation. He is also very willing to help when you need it!

Dr. Bunn is one of the driest teachers I have ever met. Sometimes he can move a little fast, so its hard to get down what he is writing on the board and what is on the powerpoint without missing something.  The tests aren't terrible but not easy.  He is really helpful if you put in effort to see him about homework and tests.
Dr. Bunn can explain the inexplicable. Basically, if it doesn't make sense, he can convince you it's true anyway. PS. He's HOT! (If you're into short physics profs)

He does his best to eliminate time pressure from tests, and gives you a lot of partial credit if you have the right idea, even if you end up with the with the wrong answer.  Also, he posts detailed solutions to homework and tests on Blackboard, which is really helpful.

Ted has got to be one of the best teachers this world has ever seen i fully recommend him. he knows everything on black holes and at the end of the day he is class. He helped me and my peers in a massive science project. I love him. Jeremy Stevens of his class.

I had Prof Bunn a long time ago for two classes at Bates College.  He still remains as one of the most oustanding teachers that I have ever had.  I was very sad to see him leave Bates.  This guy loves his subject, has a remarkable mastery of it, and is a very fair person. Two thumbs up!!  Anyone who rates him any less is surely out of wack!

i had dr bunn both for 131/132 and 205...he was pretty good for intro but he was fantastic for modern....i didnt do all that great but hes real enthusiastic about the material and the discusstions are great. offers great help on homework and the tests are do-able.

Yo, this teacher is the MAN!!!  You can doodoo on him all day, and he won't say a word... The quizzes are easy, the homework is alright, and Bunn is cool if you give him a chance...  Plus there are computers in the class so you can just play games and go on AIM. 1

He is great!  He explains things really well in class and is really helpful if you have extra questions, always taking the time to help with any confusing subject matter.  I strongly recommend his class.

he is a little difficult to understand in class (but so is the subject matter) but is a really nice guy that wants to make sure that you understand the material.  go to him with extra questions.  you can also tell he is really smart
tests are easy
Absolutely terrible teacher. He studders and is so hard to follow. He also gets mad if you don't understand the first time. 3 hours of him is torture.
